rights.label: Access
rights.text: get a copy of the personal information we hold about you

rights.label: Deletion
rights.text: delete your account and your personal information (the right to be forgotten)

rights.label: Portability
rights.text: receive your information in a structured, machine-readable format

rights.label: Objection
rights.text: object to certain types of processing

rights.label: Restriction
rights.text: ask us to limit how we process your information

rights.label: Withdrawal of consent
rights.text: withdraw consent where processing is based on it

rights.label: Complaint
rights.text: lodge a complaint with your national data protection authority

how.note: We will tell you how to reach the authority for your country; you do not need our permission to complain.
